artifact_reader_review.conclusion: Closed public check shapes export only bounded statuses, fixed reasons and numeric measurements. Private source states and retention paths are excluded. Legacy reports acquire no synthetic public checks. Exact first-observation digest and actual returncode are joined to the new Doctor receipt. Reporting grants no retry or completion authority.

contract_assessments: Only exact signed profile@4/largest-eigenval-public@1 is admitted under the new explicit two-attempt policy; ordinary and legacy Doctor policy shapes remain separate.

Real coding child exit status is retained unchanged. Exit-zero continuation requires a registered typed failed public observation tied to the retired process, original contract, candidate hashes, modes and generation. Inconclusive exit-zero checks cannot authorize continuation.
A nonzero child may continue for the independently authorized worker_exit_nonzero reason even when a public check is inconclusive.
The original deadline and two-attempt allocation remain bound. Attempt reservation occurs before possible process dispatch; a second continuation cannot create a third attempt.
Signed literal check commands execute through the fixed isolated runner. Combined output is bounded; failed cleanup prevents observation creation and continuation.

Canonical source pins, immutable workspace inputs, full candidate byte/mode state, original requirements, selected task, boundary, policy and observation digests are joined at owner preparation and worker replay.
Serialized observations and retained historical JSON do not become live owner handles or grant completion/proof/execution/continuation authority.
The artifact reader retains native usage completeness and missing-receipt limitations; it does not sum stream events into provider usage or fabricate prior C observations.
limitations: This review ran no tests, provider calls, training, live benchmarks, containers or hidden verifier code. Test source review is not a replacement for the final qualification suites.
The reviewer authored the public profile/check generation and shared fixture files listed separately; these are context bindings, not claimed independent review of the reviewer own implementation.
The native continuation regressions use authored provider and privilege/runner seams; they are not live model or actual container performance measurements.

Public timing checks use an authored, explicitly documented stability policy and unrounded measurements. They are empirical checks, not a formal proof or a guarantee of the official hidden verifier result.
No fresh live result after these changes, token savings, benchmark score improvement, token/cost cap, or complete provider usage is claimed.
Final qualification reports, evidence documentation and generated reader validator hashes were not yet frozen for package review; a separate package consistency review is required.
regression_evidence_reviewed: Correct-but-slow and incorrect-but-fast public acceptance cases in authored profile tests; signed native public+Doctor preparation fixture.
Real bounded local subprocesses for diagnostic capture, excess output, timeout reaping, lock contention and pre-spawn expiry.

Actual separate router child processes and source-broker socket preflight with authored provider and isolated-validation runner boundaries; first child exit0 plus failed performance observation, second child exit0 plus passed observation.
Typed-handle forgery, contract substitution, source/mode drift, receipt join tampering, cleanup failure, original-deadline crossing, and no-third-attempt cases.
Owner monitor passed/failed/inconclusive outcome cases preserve recorded zero child exits and keep owner return code separate.
Read-only historical audit/accounting replay and sanitized artifact reader cases.

resolved_findings.finding: Python equality could accept bool/numeric substitutions in signed validation specs.
resolved_findings.resolution: Canonical JSON exact equality now binds the complete expected task spec after evidence identifiers are normalized.
resolved_findings.verification: Read current _spec and strict shape regression; finding originated with another reviewer.

resolved_findings.finding: Expensive signature or source replay could finish after the original deadline without a final check.
resolved_findings.resolution: Captured contract revalidation checks the original monotonic deadline after replay; retired observations check it after final source/mode joins.
resolved_findings.verification: Read regressions advancing the clock during replay and final full-state checks.

resolved_findings.finding: Execution lock waiting, runner verification and process setup could renew a relative validation timeout.
resolved_findings.resolution: A bounded execution lease starts before lock acquisition, consumes the same timeout through setup, refuses before Popen when expired, and checks completion against that deadline.
resolved_findings.verification: Read real lock-contention and clock-advanced runner setup regressions plus bounded child output and reaping cases.

resolved_findings.finding: Final initial Doctor revalidation could cross the first launch deadline after the earlier launch check.
resolved_findings.resolution: validate_first_command now checks remaining_seconds after the final Doctor revalidation and before reserving an attempt.
resolved_findings.verification: Read regression that advances the owner clock after native initial revalidation and asserts no reservation or child.

resolved_findings.finding: Two public-profile admission/source-partition producers were initially missing from benchmark archive pins.
resolved_findings.resolution: local_planning_admission.py and terminal_source_partition.py are included in the selected policy source inventory.
resolved_findings.verification: Read explicit source list and stale-hash regression.

resolved_findings.finding: Full timing measurements were redundant in the second coding prompt.
resolved_findings.resolution: Provider feedback uses five per-size median summaries while the owner retains all fifteen measurements and their observation digest.
resolved_findings.verification: Read exact feedback projection and its worker/historical binding; this is a byte-reduction design, not a measured run-token savings claim.

scope: Read-only independent review of signed public validation runtime, isolated bounded execution, explicit Doctor continuation, worker and historical joins, benchmark selector/archive wiring, and artifact-only reporting.
